statement: Dolphin decodes speaker sample format 0x40 as signed 8-bit PCM expanded to 16-bit samples and format 0x00 as two 4-bit Yamaha ADPCM samples per encoded byte, rejecting other formats. For PCM it calculates nominal sample rate as 12,000,000 divided by the little-endian register divisor; for ADPCM it uses 6,000,000 divided by that divisor. A zero divisor or empty block exits without playback. Its mixer applies an additional output-rate conversion factor; these values describe Dolphin's emulation, not measured retail clock accuracy.

applicability.scope: Speaker.cpp 63-105, 134-139. Agrees at format and divisor level with wii-gap-wiibrew-speaker-sample-formats-pacing; physical host pacing still unknown.
